text: Mesoporous silica particles were synthesized by a modified sol-gel route. Tetraethyl orthosilicate (TEOS) was added dropwise to an ethanol-water mixture at 40 C. The suspension was stirred for 6 h and then aged overnight without further treatment.

The obtained particles was washed three times with ethanol and dried under vacuum. In order to be able to remove the residual template, the powder were calcined at 550 C for 5 h. The heating rate was kept at 2 C per minute [12].

text: Surface functionalization was carried out with 3-aminopropyltriethoxysilane (APTES). The silane was grafted in anhydrous toluene under reflux for 12 h. Unreacted silane was removed by Soxhlet extraction [15].

A grafting density were estimated from thermogravimetric analysis. Nitrogen adsorption isotherms are recorded at 77 K, and the specific surface area was calculated by the BET method. The pore size distribution was obtained from the desorption branch.

The functionalized particles may aggregate when the ionic strength exceeds 0.1 mol/L. This behaviour was not observed for the unmodified support. Samples were therefore dispersed by sonication before each measurement.

It should be noted that the fact that the reaction proceeds slowly at room temperature is due to the fact that the silane hydrolysis is rate limiting. Due to this reason, all grafting experiments were performed at 80 C.
FTIR spectra confirmed the presence of amine groups after functionalization. A band at 1560 cm-1 was assigned to N-H bending. The intensity of this band increased with the APTES loading.
The results shows that the adsorption capacity increased from 12.5 to 48.3 mg/g. This increase are attributed to the higher density of accessible amine sites [21].
The isotherms were fitted with the Langmuir and Freundlich models. The Langmuir model gave the better fit, with R2 above 0.99. Fitting parameters are summarized in Table 2.
Owing to the fact that the amine groups are protonated at low pH, the uptake decreased below pH 4. In addition, and moreover, the competing protons reduces the number of available sites.

No significant loss of capacity was detected after five adsorption-desorption cycles. The material could therefore be regenerated without additional treatment. Long-term stability beyond ten cycles was not evaluated in this work.

The proposed mechanism are consistent with the spectroscopic evidence discussed above. Further work will be needed to confirm the coordination geometry, which was not resolved by the present measurements.
